2609.40221.title: PhantomEnvironments: Training LLM Agents in Fictional Worlds
2609.40221.paper_summary: Training LLM agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environments, which must provide verifiable rewards, support long-horizon interaction, and scale cheaply. Existing approaches rely on costly human-curated data or on LLM-generated environments that risk hallucinations and benchmark contamination. We show that LLMs can instead be trained into capable search agents using synthetic environments generated entirely by rules, whose generation requires no LLM and has zero marginal cost. We build PhantomEnvironments, multi-turn RL environments from fictional worlds, where agents must search a corpus of templated articles to answer multi-hop questions. Despite sharing no facts with the real world, these strikingly simple environments yield agents that transfer to real-world multi-hop search benchmarks, often outperforming real-world training data on newer benchmarks. Trained agents generalize to unseen fictional universes, and Qwen models learn to scale their search budget roughly linearly with question difficulty, suggesting emergent search scaling from environment interaction alone. Ablating environment complexity reveals that hop count drives transfer more than constraints or comparisons: even the simplest rule-generated environments are a surprisingly effective, free resource for training generalizable LLM agents.
2609.40221.paper_summary_zh: 訓練大型語言模型（LLM）代理的強化學習（RL）受到環境的瓶頸，這些環境必須提供可驗證的獎勵、支持長期互動並且具備低成本擴展性。現有的方法依賴於昂貴的人類策劃數據或LLM生成的環境，這些環境存在幻覺和基準污染的風險。我們展示了LLM可以被訓練成為有能力的搜索代理，使用完全由規則生成的合成環境，這些環境的生成不需要LLM且邊際成本為零。我們構建了PhantomEnvironments，這是來自虛構世界的多輪RL環境，代理必須搜索一組模板化的文章以回答多跳問題。儘管與現實世界沒有共享任何事實，但這些引人注目的簡單環境產生的代理在現實世界的多跳搜索基準中表現出色，常常超越現實世界的訓練數據在更新的基準上。訓練的代理能夠概括到未見過的虛構宇宙，而Qwen模型學會根據問題難度大致線性地擴展其搜索預算，這表明僅從環境互動中出現的搜索擴展。消除環境複雜性顯示，跳躍數量比約束或比較更能驅動轉移：即使是最簡單的規則生成環境也是訓練可概括的LLM代理的驚人有效且免費的資源。
